windows_intro: Download one file, run the setup and the rest happens in your browser. AI Detector runs entirely on your own Windows PC — no subscription, no cloud.
windows_download_desc: Download the Windows file from the latest release.
windows_req_text: You need a 64-bit PC with Windows 10 (version 22H2 or newer) or Windows 11. There is one download for every PC: AI Detector picks the fastest way to run on your hardware by itself.
windows_hw_nvidia: PC with a supported NVIDIA graphics card
windows_engine_nvidia: The NVIDIA GPU — fastest, ideal for many cameras
windows_hw_other: PC with Intel or AMD graphics
windows_engine_other: Windows ML — fast enough for accurate detection
windows_note_text: Windows on ARM (for example laptops with a Snapdragon processor) is not supported.
windows_step1_1: Open the releases page with the button above, or search Google for “ESchouten ai-detector” and click Releases on GitHub.
windows_step1_2: Under Assets of the latest release, click AI-Detector-<version>-windows-x64-setup.zip. The file is saved in your Downloads folder. You do not need a GitHub account.
windows_step1_caption: The latest release on GitHub: the Windows, macOS and Ubuntu files are listed under Assets.
windows_step2_1: Open Downloads, right-click the zip file and choose Extract All… → Extract.
windows_step2_2: Open the extracted folder and double-click the setup file.
windows_step2_3: Does a blue screen appear saying “Windows protected your PC”? The program is safe, but it is not signed with a paid Microsoft certificate. Click More info and then Run anyway.
windows_step2_4: The setup installs AI Detector and opens it. On the first launch you are asked whether AI Detector may start when you log in: choose Yes, so monitoring continues by itself after a restart or power cut.
windows_keep_1: Use a network cable. Connect both the PC and the IP cameras with a wired connection (UTP/ethernet). Wi-Fi in a barn can be unstable, which makes the camera pictures stutter.
windows_keep_2: No sleep settings needed. While monitoring is on, AI Detector keeps the PC awake by itself. A laptop still goes to sleep when you close the lid or when it runs on battery — so keep a laptop open and plugged in.
windows_keep_3: Updates. Choose Check for Updates in the AI Detector menu (the icon next to the clock). Detectors made from a preset also get newer models by themselves.
